scope: Verification against unchanged original requirement contracts; no new semantic scores.

items.requirement: 按永久服务错误、可重试网络错误、输出截断和语义不确定性分别处理
items.acceptance_criterion: 401/402及时结束；网络重试有界；相同截断不整轮无限复播；中止原因准确。
items.scope: Actual Pi/HTTP controlled-provider tests cover immediate 401/402 stop, bounded transient 503 retry, separate typed output-limit handling, finite definition-group bisection and singleton termination. Permanent/network failures do not trigger length splitting; valid partial results survive. Source hashes match the tested deployed release.
items.limitations: Controlled-provider mechanism verification, not a new official-model run. Automatic group bisection applies to definition review; the remaining five historical groups still await funded semantic execution.

items.requirement: 按需组织原文、相关目录与既有结果，避免每小组反复携带全目录
items.acceptance_criterion: 记录每阶段输入token、输出token、调用次数和耗时；复用有效成果可审计。
items.scope: Per-group related concepts and shared evidence are selected, old verbose tool results are projected without changing persisted messages, and runtime accounting records calls/tokens/time including failed and nested requests. Actual clean2 reused 44 earlier results and added 38; all 82 raw result identities were independently checked.
items.limitations: Observed first-input reduction 224664 to 211776 (5.7%) is not an equal-input causal A/B comparison and input remains large. The original clean2 provenance report remains failed because historical registrations were incomplete; no old registrations were fabricated.

items.requirement: 相同输入并发推理的缓存和审计引用保持真实owner与不可变结果对应
items.acceptance_criterion: 两个会话同时完成同键结果；每份已接受报告仍可逐字对应其原始调用，取消一方不影响另一方。
items.scope: Same-key work shares the immutable first successful result with original owner/hash; cancellation publishes no cancelled winner. Actual isolated Pi/MCP/SQLite cancellation and surviving-session ownership checks pass 9/9; accepted source results correspond to their original provider response.
items.limitations: Cancellation integration uses a deterministic provider, not a model-quality test. The original 44 missing registration records are still absent; v07 explicit revalidation receipts have fixture coverage but await actual clean3 execution.

items.acceptance_criterion: 单项失败不损坏其他成果；记录并发上限和资源/模型预算。
items.scope: Finite parser/processing/extraction/review executors and shared model-budget reservations are implemented; controlled cancellation leaves the other task complete and successful results intact. Independent local 1/2/4-client observation reports 280 successful reads, latency and resource usage.
items.limitations: Per-executor bounds and a four-client local observation do not establish a global enterprise capacity limit or service SLA; no latency threshold was added after observing results.

items.requirement: 同项目共享资料和研究成果，独立会话保留独立上下文
items.acceptance_criterion: 两会话可引用同项目已完成产物，不串会话指令或污染其他项目。
items.scope: Two real DeepSeek conversations used shared project research artifacts; the second read saved revisions and dependency status. Pi lifecycle and project-scope tests separately verify independent persistent histories and project isolation.
items.limitations: The actual two-chat research task used declared synthetic financial assumptions. Cross-chat sharing is verified; actual-company source interpretation and full research correctness remain incomplete.

items.requirement: 会话按需读取索引、memo、原文与计算产物
items.acceptance_criterion: 回答引用来自真实读取；大型历史不逐轮全量复制。
items.scope: The actual second conversation listed and read existing scenario/DCF artifacts and referenced their revisions. Page/table/index/artifact tools support selective retrieval; legacy verbose tool payload projection preserves persisted financial values and message history.
items.limitations: This verifies actual reads and selective context assembly, not that every answer is correct or context use is globally optimal.

items.requirement: 多会话独立取消、恢复和续跑
items.acceptance_criterion: 取消一方后另一方完成；重启可继续有效成果，不重复全量模型调用。
items.scope: Actual isolated Pi/HTTP/MCP/SQLite integration verifies cancelled owner and completed surviving conversation; manager recovery retains independent histories. Actual clean2 reused 44 accepted prior facts and added 38 rather than replaying all model work.
items.limitations: Control-flow recovery uses deterministic provider fixtures; actual clean2 remains only 61/66 groups. v07 historical-length scheduling and new revalidation receipts await funded continuation.

items.requirement: 支持搜索网页与公司公告并获取原文
items.acceptance_criterion: 对既定研究任务找到可核查的一手来源，并记录实际查询与结果。
items.scope: The recorded real Pi task made three Tavily queries, handled a failed source URL and fetched the official company news page. Requested numbers were checked against the archived 27309-byte source with its original hash.
items.limitations: This verifies search and original-source acquisition for this task only. An added consolidated-scope label lacks support in the cited paragraph and is not certified; full actual-company announcement/PDF research remains incomplete.

items.requirement: 保存来源、发布日期、访问时间、URL、证据片段、内容哈希与快照
items.acceptance_criterion: 陈旧/修订/相互冲突来源按时间及版本区分，每个关键事实可回原文。
items.scope: Two actual DeepSeek conversations read four immutable archived sources, retained a before-cutoff conflict, excluded a later revision from the earlier cutoff, and grounded the recorded financial observations in original paragraphs. Snapshot and source bytes remain unchanged.
items.limitations: Dates and revision relationships in this controlled task were synthetic. Real historical website availability is not established; the real LiuGong source published_at remains unknown rather than invented. Original strict scores 12/18 and 6/18 remain failed; this is a capability-contract audit, not a replacement score.

items.requirement: 网页只能作为外部证据，不获得运行指令权限
items.acceptance_criterion: 包含网页提示注入的固定样例无法改变工具权限或读取项目外秘密。
items.scope: Both actual conversations read the fixed malicious webpage passage. The recorded runs show zero sensitive/cross-project attempts, zero external fetch/search during that task and no sentinel leakage. Project-scope host checks separately reject foreign-source access.
items.limitations: One visible synthetic injection sample establishes only the original fixed-example contract, not general prompt-injection robustness. Original failed aggregate research-trust scores are unchanged.

items.requirement: 支持离线回放固定证据及重现研究结果
items.acceptance_criterion: 断网后基于冻结快照重复计算与核验；不将新网页内容偷偷混入旧结论。
items.scope: Current ResearchStore and actual MCP calculate_financial_metrics repeated two reads and eight calculations from the frozen real company source with external networking disabled. Regional sum, difference and shares match in both rounds; 12/12 control checks and 8/8 independent Fraction checks pass.
items.limitations: Zero model calls: verifies evidence and calculation-tool replay, not repeatability of LLM interpretations. Figures retain original rounded news precision; source-to-input citations are explicitly recorded in the test ledger, not automatically attached by scalar calculations. Windows asyncio loopback self-pipe sockets were allowed and logged; no external network attempt occurred.
